name_zh: 塞达尔·桑戈尔/诗歌政治：新黑人运动书写与文化外交
name_en: Senghor/Poetry Politics: Negritude Writing & Cultural Diplomacy
description_zh: 列奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔 (1906-2001) 塞内加尔首任总统 (1960-1980)，新黑人运动创始人，诗人政治家。核心思想：新黑人运动——黑人文化价值肯定/非洲人格尊严/文化多元主义/文明互补；政治实践：1960 独立/非洲社会主义/法语共同体/一党制/1980 主动退位/法兰西学院院士。体现 M165 新黑人运动书写——以"诗歌即政治+黑人文化即资产+文明互补即外交+退位即民主"四位一体，在殖民遗产/法语霸权/部落分裂中构建文化主权国家。
description_en: Leopold Sedar Senghor (1906-2001) Senegal first President (1960-1980), Negritude founder, poet-statesman. Core thought: Negritude—Black culture affirmation/African personality dignity/cultural pluralism/civilizational complementarity; political praxis: 1960 independence/African socialism/Francophonie/one-party/1980 voluntary retirement/Académie française member. Exemplifies M165 Negritude Writing—quaternity of 'poetry as politics + Black culture as asset + civilizational complementarity as diplomacy + retirement as democracy' constructing cultural sovereignty nation amid colonial legacy/French hegemony/tribal divisions.
reason_zh: 桑戈尔非单纯政治家，而是"诗人即政治家+黑人文化即外交资产+文明互补即世界观"三位一体。以诗歌重构黑人尊严，以文化外交超越法语霸权，以主动退位树立民主标杆。M165 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M165 离散叙事(台湾)、M186 泛非(政治)，核心在于"诗歌即政治行动+黑人文化即文明资产+文明互补即外交策略"的知识分子政治范式。
reason_en: Senghor not mere politician but trinity of 'poet as politician + Black culture as diplomatic asset + civilizational complementarity as worldview'. Poetry reconstructs Black dignity, cultural diplomacy transcends French hegemony, voluntary retirement sets democratic benchmark. M165 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (LatAm), M165 Diasporic Narrative (Taiwan), M186 Pan-African (political), core: 'poetry as political action + Black culture as civilizational asset + civilizational complementarity as diplomatic strategy' intellectual politics paradigm.
steps_zh: 新黑人运动思想构建：1930s 巴黎《黑人学生》/《黑人》杂志/艾梅·塞泽尔/达马/黑人文化价值/非洲人格/文明互补
诗歌即政治行动：《黑人诗集》/《致未生的黑人》/《埃莱吉》/诗歌重构黑人尊严/反殖民/肯定非洲文化价值
文化外交与法语共同体：1960 独立/法语共同体/达喀尔黑人艺术节/1966 世界黑人艺术节/文化外交替代军事外交
民主退位与制度遗产：1980 主动退位/迪乌夫继任/多党制/法兰西学院首位黑人院士/塞内加尔民主稳定标杆/非洲治理模范
遗产与复兴：新黑人运动复兴/非洲文学/文化产业/达喀尔双年展/青年诗人/非洲文明对话
steps_en: Negritude thought construction: 1930s Paris 'L'Etudiant Noir'/'Présence Africaine'/Aimé Césaire/Damas/Black culture value/African personality/civilizational complementarity
Poetry as political action: 'Anthologie de la nouvelle poésie nègre'/'Élegies'/poetry reconstructs Black dignity/anti-colonial/affirms African cultural value
Cultural diplomacy & Francophonie: 1960 independence/Francophonie/Dakar Negro Arts Festival/1966 World Festival of Negro Arts/cultural diplomacy replaces military diplomacy

Democratic retirement & institutional legacy: 1980 voluntary retirement/Diouf succeeds/multi-party/Académie française first Black member/Senegal democratic stability benchmark/African governance model
Legacy & revival: Negritude revival/African literature/cultural industries/Dakar Biennale/youth poets/African civilization dialogue
expected_zh: 以"诗歌即政治+黑人文化即资产+文明互补即外交+退位即民主"四位一体，在殖民遗产/法语霸权/部落分裂中构建文化主权国家，为非洲知识分子政治提供诗歌即政治的双重范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'poetry as politics + Black culture as asset + civilizational complementarity as diplomacy + retirement as democracy' constructs cultural sovereignty nation amid colonial legacy/French hegemony/tribal divisions, providing dual paradigm of poetry as politics for African intellectual politics.
